Interface EDPServerAction

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BlockingActionMessageSource, EDPMessageSource, EDPProgressMessageSource
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    EDPEditor, EDPQuery, EDPSession

    public interface EDPServerAction
extends EDPMessageSource, EDPProgressMessageSource, BlockingActionMessageSource
    Represents any server action which can be identified with an "action ID". This is an abstraction of EDPSession, EDPQuery, EDPEditor.
    Author:
    xg

      • hasExtendedLifeCycle

        boolean hasExtendedLifeCycle()
        Indicates whether this instance has extended life cycle enabled. If yes, this instance occupies a server resource which has to be released explicitely using release()
        Returns:
        whether the instance has extended life cycle enabled

      • release

        void release()
      throws ServerActionException
        Releases the server resource which is occupied by this instance. This method must be called after work with a server action instance for which extended life cycle has been enabled.
        Throws:
        ServerActionException - If an error occurs.
        Since:
        abas Version 2015r3, EDP Version 3.45
        See Also:
        hasExtendedLifeCycle()
        EDP Kommando:
        AID

      • isReleased
